If you visit, I strongly recommend ordering Course A, which includes the raw anchovy salad. ``` ## Review Visiting Geoje, I wanted to try some of the island's unique specialties, which led me to this restaurant. It was a place where you could taste anchovies far larger than the ones we typically eat, and I made a special trip here because it is a rare and precious spot where you can enjoy fresh raw anchovy. Upon arriving, parking was available right in front of the restaurant. Fitting for a popular spot, the parking area was quite spacious, but many cars were already parked there, showing that quite a crowd had arrived early. ```adcard ``` Looking through reviews beforehand, everyone seemed to recommend ordering the Anchovy Ssambap Set Course A, so we ordered it right away without hesitation. We arrived a bit early for dinner, and shortly after placing our order, locals began trickling in one after another, quickly filling up most of the tables. The food was served promptly after ordering. Although it's called anchovy ssambap (rice wraps), the main dish actually looked like an anchovy stew, and the seasoned raw anchovy salad was served right along with it. According to the instructions, you boil the stew for another 1 to 2 minutes, then wrap it with rice and whatever side dishes or ingredients you like, just like regular ssambap. ```adcard ``` Seeing such gigantic anchovies for the first time was slightly startling, but fortunately, I was able to enjoy them without any aversion. Because of a subtle characteristic fishiness, these giant anchovies might not be for everyone. The main stew had a familiar, comforting flavor that many of us know, but the seasoned raw anchovy salad offered a unique taste I had never experienced before. The texture of the large raw anchovies was far more tender and flavorful than I had expected. ```adcard ``` I immediately understood why all the reviews insisted on ordering the seasoned raw anchovy salad. If you plan to visit, I also strongly urge you to order Course A to get the anchovy salad. The restaurant provides plenty of fresh vegetables with a self-service refill bar, so you can enjoy as many wraps as you like. If you want to experience the genuine ocean aroma of Geoje, this is definitely a place worth visiting at least once. ## Pictures
